FabFilter Total Bundle.notes: FabFilter only discounts once/year at Black Friday: 25% off. Regular price ~$1176 at PB.

FabFilter Creative Bundle.notes: BF 2024: $269 at PB (lowest recorded). Typical BF/IMSTA sale 25% off = ~$321.

Soundtoys 5.5.notes: Frequent 50% off sales at PB. April 2026 sale was $299 (50% off $599). ATL ~$239 recorded at various retailers. Additional research (2026-07-10): official Soundtoys.com Black Friday 2024 price was $199 (regular was $499 pre-2025 price increase); 2025 summer sale ran $299 (50% off $599) through Aug 5, 2025 — consistent with existing tracked figures.

iZotope Music Production Suite.notes: Regular price $999 (iZotope direct) / $905 at PB. Sale prices 40-50% off. ATL $362 (Aug 2023, Bestservice). Apr 2026: $678 at Gear4music.

NI Komplete 15 Standard.notes: PB regularly runs 50% off NI Komplete (Feb 2025, BF 2025). ATL $266 at Thomann (Nov 2024).

NI Komplete 15 Ultimate.notes: PB runs 50% off during major sales (BF, summer). Typical sale ~50% off = $659. Lowest tracked $266 (plugindeals.net (Thomann) 2024-11-28).

Waves Gold Bundle.notes: Waves runs very aggressive flash sales. Regular ~$799-$879 but frequently at $99-$175. ATL $79.99 (Feb 2026 flash sale).

Waves Platinum Bundle.notes: Waves Platinum list price is ~$1999 but almost always on deep sale ($77-$199). PB 14th Anniversary: £99. July 2025: $199. ATL ~$77 (recurring flash sales).

Baby Audio Complete Bundle.notes: 14-plugin bundle (Crystalline, Transit 2, TAIP, Super VHS, Parallel Aggressor, BA-1, Humanoid, etc.), regular $399. Recent 96-hour flash sale at $299 (~25% off) reported via Plugin Alliance listing.

EastWest Composer Cloud+.notes: EastWest ComposerCloud+ subscription (43,000+ instruments). Not sold via Plugin Boutique — direct/Sweetwater/Musician's Friend only. Regular $19.99/mo or $149/yr; frequent first-year promos to ~$99/yr; student-only plans run $49-69/yr.

Output One (Arcade).notes: Output. The standalone Arcade subscription has been folded into Output One ($14.99/mo or $119.99/yr, includes Arcade + Co-Producer + Output FX plugins). Not sold via Plugin Boutique. A Reason+ & Arcade bundle promo briefly offered $149 for the first year, and existing Arcade subscribers have migration/loyalty pricing, but no general public discount is documented for Output One itself.

Waves Mercury Bundle.notes: Waves. Not sold on Plugin Boutique. Nominal/full list price is $7,599 but the actual standing price almost everyone pays is $1,999 (marketed as '74% off'). No confirmed price below $1,999 was found.

Plugin Alliance CORE Subscription.notes: Plugin Alliance. All-access subscription is now branded 'CORE Subscription' ($14.99/mo or $149.99/yr for 200+ plugins); a premium 'Everything Bundle' tier is $29.99/mo or $299.99/yr. The older 'MEGA Bundle' name is no longer used. Not confirmed as sold via Plugin Boutique. No discount/sale data was found in research.

Slate Digital Complete Access.notes: Slate Digital. The former 'All Access Pass' has been folded into 'Complete Access' (Slate Digital + SSL + Harrison), $19.99/mo or $199.99/yr, no long-term commitment. Not sold via Plugin Boutique (only individual perpetual Slate licenses are). A student/faculty rate ($99.99/yr, 50% off) exists but is eligibility-restricted, not a general public sale.

UAD Spark.notes: Universal Audio. UAD Spark subscription, $19.99/mo or $149.99/yr, sold directly via uaudio.com only (not Plugin Boutique). Black Friday deals have cut the annual price to ~$79 ('Save 47%'); a recurring first-year promo of ~$99/yr is also common, plus a 3-months-for-$0.99 new-subscriber intro offer.

Cableguys ShaperBox 3.notes: Central multieffect host bundling all Cableguys Shaper modules (Volume/Filter/Pan/Width/Time/Pitch/Drive/Noise/Reverb Shaper). Cableguys offers frequent discounts and upgrade-bundle pricing (price tier estimated; exact current USD not published in a single official table).

Arturia V Collection 11 Pro.notes: Regular $699-$769. Typical sale 50% off = $349 (BF 2025, PB 14th Anniversary Feb 2026). ATL $295 at Thomann (Nov 2025). | 2026-07-12: PB現行はIntro/Pro二本立て。本エントリはPro版。旧標準版のresearch履歴は分離済み

Arturia FX Collection 6 Pro.notes: Released Feb 2026. MSRP $499 at Arturia direct / $549 at PB. Arturia typically runs 50% off during BF/summer sales. | 2026-07-12: PB現行はIntro/Pro二本立て。本エントリはPro版。旧標準版のresearch履歴は分離済み

FabFilter Pro-Q 4.notes: FabFilter discounts 25% once/year at Black Friday only. ATL $105.25 at Gear4Music (BF Nov 2025). PB BF 2024/2025: 25% off = $149.

FabFilter Pro-C 2.notes: FabFilter discounts 25% at Black Friday only. Typical BF sale ~$97 (25% off $129).

FabFilter Pro-L 2.notes: FabFilter discounts 25% at Black Friday only. Typical BF sale ~$134 (25% off $179).

Kilohearts Phase Plant.notes: PB 14th Anniversary Feb 2026: $119 (40% off). ATL $92 recorded at Plugin Boutique. Kilohearts runs regular 40-50% off sales at PB.

Serum 2.notes: Xfer's official price is $249 (2026). Xfer's founder has stated publicly that Xfer does not run promotions/sales on the perpetual license. Historical intro price $99 (Mar 2025) and a one-off $189 sale (May 2025) are kept below as legacy data points; no recurring sale pattern confirmed.

iZotope Ozone 11 Standard.notes: iZotope runs regular 50% off sales. ATL $70.26 at Best Service (BF Nov 2024). PB BF 2024: also deep discount. Frequent sales throughout year.

iZotope Ozone 11 Advanced.notes: iZotope runs 50% off sales. ATL $141.40 at Best Service (BF Nov 2024). Consider upgrading from Standard instead.

Valhalla Room.notes: Valhalla DSP maintains a fixed $50 price across all retailers and does not offer discounts. Best price you'll ever see IS $50.

Valhalla VintageVerb.notes: Valhalla DSP maintains a fixed $50 price. No discounts ever. Valhalla Supermassive is free (no purchase needed).

Native Instruments Massive X.notes: Regular $199 at NI & Plugin Boutique. Frequently discounted ~50-55%; typical sale $85-$100. ATL $85 recorded at Gear4Music (Sep 19, 2025), $88 at Thomann (Dec 11, 2024), per plugindeals.net price history.

u-he Diva.notes: Regular ~$179 (179 EUR) direct from u-he & Plugin Boutique. Goes on sale a few times/year incl. Black Friday/Cyber Monday (~50% off) and other seasonal retailer promos; reported sale price ~$89 at Sweetwater (anecdotal, not a tracked price-history record).

u-he Repro.notes: Repro-1 + Repro-5 bundle, regular $149 direct from u-he & Plugin Boutique. Periodic retailer discounts; Equipboard reports street prices $79.99-$99. No official published sale calendar found.

Arturia Pigments.notes: Latest version Pigments 7, regular $199 at Arturia & Plugin Boutique. Frequently ~50% off ($99) during version-launch intro sales, Black Friday, and seasonal campaigns. Occasional deeper loyalty pricing (~$69) for existing Arturia customers only, not public sale price.

Spectrasonics Omnisphere.notes: Now Omnisphere 3 (successor to Omnisphere 2), regular $499 new license direct from Spectrasonics. NOT sold on Plugin Boutique — download editions exclusively via Spectrasonics webstore, boxed via authorized resellers. Spectrasonics does not run promotional sales; only fixed upgrade pricing ($199 from prior Omnisphere, $249 from Atmosphere). Minor retailer discounts (~$400-479) exist but are not official sales, so no typical_sale recorded.

reFX Nexus 5.notes: Nexus 5 Starter edition, regular $249 direct from reFX (NOT sold on Plugin Boutique). Runs Black Friday/Christmas sales (~$179-199) and periodic anniversary/bundle promos with expansions at 20-55% off.

LennarDigital Sylenth1.notes: Regular EUR139/~$149 direct from LennarDigital (also monthly subscription ~$9.95/mo). Infrequent, shallow discounts — the only tracked sale in available price-history data was $135 (~10% off) on 2022-10-13, per musicsoftwaredeals.com (dated; may not reflect current sale depth). Not confirmed as sold on Plugin Boutique.

iZotope Ozone 12 Advanced.notes: Ozone 12 Advanced is the current flagship mastering suite (regular $499 direct/NI/PB); Ozone 12 'Standard' tier has been discontinued — the 2026 lineup is Advanced ($499) + Elements ($55) only. Discounted to $366 at Thomann (Mar 20, 2026) per plugindeals.net — lowest recorded 2026 sale. Existing-customer loyalty pricing from $279 also available (NI account required, not a public sale).

iZotope Neutron 5.notes: Full Neutron 5 mixing suite, regular $299 direct from iZotope. Often street-priced lower even outside sales (e.g. $274 Thomann, $222 Music Store). Plugin Boutique periodically runs ~25% off promos on the upgrade SKU specifically ($199 to $149); full-license sale depth not separately confirmed, so all_time_low left null.

FabFilter Pro-R 2.notes: Regular $169 direct from FabFilter (also sold on Plugin Boutique, exact product URL not verified this pass). Like other FabFilter plugins, discounts primarily once/year at Black Friday, ~25-30% off (consistent with the Pro-Q4/Pro-C2/Pro-L2 pattern already tracked) — inferred ~$118-135 sale range; no specific dated Pro-R2 sale price confirmed yet.

oeksound Soothe2.notes: Superseded by Soothe3 ($259 new, $55 upgrade from Soothe 1/2) as of 2026 — oeksound now positions Soothe2 as a legacy product. Soothe2's standard price was ~$199; user/press reports of Black Friday sales to ~$139 (~30% off), e.g. Attack Magazine BF pricing GBP169 to GBP119.

Soundtheory Gullfoss.notes: Regular $199 direct from Soundtheory. Occasional promo-code discounts (~$127-139, e.g. Sound On Sound code SOS30); no confirmed regular/predictable sale calendar — timing appears irregular. Plugin Boutique availability not confirmed from research.

Sonible smart:EQ 4.notes: Regular $129, sold on Plugin Boutique (exact product URL not confirmed this pass). Frequent promos: common sale ~$79 (~40% off); deeper manufacturer-focus sales down to ~$49 (up to 75% off), e.g. Plugin Boutique promo through Mar 31, 2026 per rekkerd.org. Also bundled with smart:comp/smart:limit at an effective ~$50/plugin.

XLN Audio RC-20 Retro Color.notes: Regular $99 at XLN Audio & Plugin Boutique. Frequent deep discounts: $49 (Rekkerd, through Aug 12 2026) and $39 on Plugin Boutique (through Jun 14 2026). One price-tracker listed an outlier low of ~$17.28 (Mar 2023) — excluded here as unconfirmed/likely anomalous.

Baby Audio Crystalline.notes: Algorithmic reverb, regular $99 at Baby Audio & Plugin Boutique. Baby Audio runs frequent site-wide sales (~30-40% off across the catalog) but no Crystalline-specific sale price was confirmed in this research pass.

Output Portal.notes: Granular FX plugin, regular $149 (also via Output One subscription $9.99-14.99/mo, or Splice rent-to-own $9.99/mo x15). Frequent ~50% off sales (~$74.50) at Plugin Boutique/Best Service; deepest recorded ATL $61 at Thomann (Black Friday, Nov 22, 2024) per plugindeals.net.

Native Instruments Kontakt 8.notes: Full sampler, regular $299 at NI & Plugin Boutique. No confirmed official sale calendar for the full standard license found in this pass; a crossgrade/upgrade path (~$149, eligibility-restricted) exists but is not equivalent to a public discount on the full license, so no typical_sale recorded.

Vital.notes: Basic tier is fully free with the complete synth engine (all features), ~75 presets/25 wavetables. Paid Plus (~$25) and Pro (~$80) tiers only add more bundled presets/wavetables/content — same engine, not a 'sale'. Sold direct from vital.audio only; no evidence of Plugin Boutique distribution or recurring discount sales.

u-he Hive 2.notes: u-he. Regular promo ~30% off ($104). Documented Black Friday low of $65 in 2022 and 2023 (Reddit r/AudioProductionDeals tracking thread); missed the BF sale in 2024.

u-he Bazille.notes: u-he. Typical PB promo ~30% off (~$90). Deeper direct-from-u-he Autumn Sale 2025 hit 50% off (€64.50), Nov 18–Dec 3 2025.

Synapse Audio Dune 3.notes: Developer is Synapse Audio (not Xfer Records). Not documented as sold on Plugin Boutique. Group/coupon deals have hit $74.76; a $99 Thomann price is described as the closest to typical Black-Friday-level pricing.

Vengeance Sound Avenger 2.notes: Vengeance Sound. Black Friday promo documented at 33% off ($150.75). A $98 low was reported at Thomann on Jan 6, 2025 (plugindeals.net) but is treated as an unconfirmed outlier and not used as the all-time low.

KV331 Audio SynthMaster 3.notes: KV331 Audio. Winter sale $49 (~50% off); Summer Sale $59 (~40% off). No source explicitly labels either price as an all-time low.

Reveal Sound Spire.notes: Reveal Sound. Recurring flash sales to $75–$76 (~60% off); documented low $66 at Best Service on May 16, 2026 (and previously Dec 20, 2025). Reddit users cite a usual sale price around $100.

Native Instruments Massive.notes: NI's original/classic Massive (not Massive X) — still sold, not discontinued. Nov 2025 Plugin Boutique promo gave it away free with any purchase rather than a cash discount, so no reliable typical sale price is documented.

GForce OB-E.notes: GForce Software. Not documented as sold on Plugin Boutique. Current promo price $119 (~30% off $169.99) appears to be the standing price at both GForce direct and Sweetwater; no dated Black Friday figure or confirmed all-time low was found.

Cherry Audio GX-80.notes: Cherry Audio. Blockbuster Sale price $39 (44% off) matched at Plugin Boutique (43% off until Jun 1); no source shows a lower documented promo price.

Tokyo Dawn Labs TDR Nova GE.notes: Tokyo Dawn Labs. Frequently discounted at Plugin Boutique to ~$19 (68% off); direct Summer Sale price €39 (35% off). Documented lowest-ever price $14 at AudioDeluxe on Jul 4, 2024 (plugindeals.net).

DMG Audio EQuilibrium.notes: DMG Audio, sold direct only (not on Plugin Boutique). A third-party aggregator (pluginplug.io) shows $130 and $100 price points with no clear dates, so these are not counted as a confirmed sale or low.

Waves SSL E-Channel.notes: Waves. Not currently sold on Plugin Boutique (historical PB listing only). Effectively in a near-permanent sale at $34.99 (77% off $149 MSRP); reseller PluginDiscounts cited $31.46 as a documented low, though the exact date wasn't specified in the source.

Sonnox Oxford EQ.notes: Sonnox. HDX/HD version historically sold via Plugin Boutique (regular ~$474); native plugin lists direct at £239.99 with a 75% off Summer Sale to £59.99. Lowest recorded PB price $47 on Jul 14, 2025 (plugindeals.net).

Klanghelm MJUC.notes: Klanghelm, sold direct only (not on Plugin Boutique). Stable everyday-low price (~€24); MJUC jr is free. No documented sales or Black Friday discounts — an old ~€23-24 intro price from launch is essentially unchanged from today's price.

Klanghelm DC8C mkII.notes: Klanghelm, sold direct only (not on Plugin Boutique). No sales/Black Friday discounting documented; price has only crept up slowly over time (~€20 circa 2014 to ~€23-24 today) rather than via time-limited markdowns.

Wavesfactory Trackspacer.notes: Wavesfactory. Moderate promos to $36 (38% off); deeper sales recur at $29 (~51% off), most recently documented Dec 8, 2025 at Plugin Boutique (musicsoftwaredeals.com).

Waves CLA-2A.notes: Waves. Sold individually on Plugin Boutique. Full non-sale list is typically $149-199; also bundled in the $89.99 CLA Classic Compressors bundle, which itself drops to $29.99-$49.99 on sale. Lowest tracked $21.8 (plugindeals.net (Thomann) 2022-11-25).

Waves CLA-76.notes: Waves. Sold individually on Plugin Boutique alongside CLA-2A (same 2026 Band Month promo, $29.99 / 79% off); the exact PB product-page ID wasn't confirmed in research, so a PB search link is used instead of guessing the ID.

UAD 1176 Classic Limiter Collection.notes: Universal Audio. Available as a perpetual purchase (not subscription-only) via uaudio.com and resellers including Plugin Boutique. Common sale price $49 (67% off); documented low $29 at Plugin Boutique on May 3, 2025 (plugindeals.net).

LiquidSonics Cinematic Rooms MKII.notes: LiquidSonics. Not sold on Plugin Boutique — direct only. Standard $199 / Professional $399. Launch intro pricing was ~35% off; bundles see 12-37% off, and a Black-Friday 'Ultimate Bundle' reportedly hit ~63% off across multiple products, but no single-product all-time low is confirmed.

Eventide Blackhole.notes: Eventide. Sold on both Eventide's own store and Plugin Boutique at $99. Frequent promos to $39-$49; a coupon-driven deal reached $29 (87% off), but plugindeals.net's price-history tracker documents an earlier, lower $24.90 at Thomann on Nov 29, 2022.

Relab Development LX480 Complete.notes: Relab Development. Sold via Plugin Boutique among other resellers (Dual-Engine Reverb V4 = the 'Complete' tier). Band Month sale price $149 (57% off $349). The cut-down Essentials tier ($99 reg.) separately hits $29 (70% off), but that figure doesn't apply to the Complete/Dual-Engine version.

Softube Tape.notes: Softube. Sold on Plugin Boutique at $99. Single-plugin sales typically ~$79-$89.99 (10-20% off); the Softube Producers Collection bundle ($139 for 13 plugins) was separately called 'lowest price ever' for that bundle, not for standalone Tape.

Wavesfactory Cassette.notes: Wavesfactory. Sold on Plugin Boutique at the standard $59 price; no reliable sale, discount percentage, or Black Friday pricing was found in research as of mid-2026.

u-he Satin.notes: u-he. Recurring promo to $89-$90 (~30-31% off $129). A third-party aggregator (Equipboard) lists prices as low as $39, but with no dated primary source, so it isn't counted as a confirmed all-time low.

Baby Audio TAIP.notes: Baby Audio. Sold on Plugin Boutique at $99. A YouTube review referenced a ~90%-off sale down to about $9.99, but this is a single anecdotal/YouTube-sourced reference with no confirmed date, so it is not used as a tracked sale or all-time-low figure.

iZotope Ozone Elements.notes: iZotope Ozone 12 Elements. Sold on Plugin Boutique per MusicTech coverage of a 'lowest price ever' PB promotion on Mar 19, 2026 (no exact PB product URL confirmed in research). iZotope's own Summer Sale (Jun 2026) separately offered Elements-tier plugins at $25 each.

Sonnox Oxford Limiter.notes: Sonnox. Sold direct; historically also available via Plugin Boutique through the 'Producer Power Bundle' (lowest recorded bundle price $49). Direct Summer Sale price £57.49 (75% off £229.99, converted here to ~$290/$72). A YouTube review mentions a $29 Black Friday 2024 price, but that single unconfirmed source isn't used as an all-time low.

DMG Audio Limitless.notes: DMG Audio, direct-sale only (not on Plugin Boutique). No documented sales or discounting pattern beyond DMG's general policy of discounting brand-new releases for their first month.

Newfangled Audio Elevate.notes: Newfangled Audio/Eventide. Not sold on Plugin Boutique. Elevate Mastering Bundle regularly discounted to $79 (~60% off $199 list). A ~$39.50 price was mentioned anecdotally in a Reddit comment but is unconfirmed and not used as an all-time low.

Spitfire Audio BBC Symphony Orchestra Pr.notes: Spitfire Audio. Not sold on Plugin Boutique — direct/Thomann only. Core tier $449, Discover tier free. Seasonal sales (incl. Black Friday) typically 30-40% off ($649-$699); documented all-time low $549 (Jan 8, 2022, musicsoftwaredeals.com). More recent 2025 Thomann lows of $582-$666 are shallower than this 2022 figure.

Spectrasonics Keyscape.notes: Spectrasonics. Not sold on Plugin Boutique — direct/authorized-dealer network only (AudioDeluxe, PluginFox, Best Service, etc). Spectrasonics avoids large seasonal discounts; documented lowest price $379 (~5% off $399) at AudioDeluxe on Jun 27, 2024 (plugindeals.net), unusually shallow for the plugin market.

UVI Falcon 3.notes: UVI (Falcon 2026 release). Sold on Plugin Boutique. Late-Oct/early-Nov 2025 intro and 'Synth Month' promos consistently priced Falcon 3 at $149 (50% off $299) across UVI direct, Plugin Boutique, and Reddit deal threads — no source shows anything lower.

XLN Audio Addictive Keys.notes: XLN Audio. Addictive Keys is sold as individual instruments (e.g. Studio Grand, priced here) as well as a $249 Complete Collection direct from XLN. Plugin Boutique promo documented at $59.40 (40% off $99); no dated all-time-low record was found.

Toontrack EZdrummer 3.notes: Toontrack. Not confirmed as sold on Plugin Boutique. Standard $179, with a recurring 25% off promo to $134 (Thomann shows $122, a deeper ~32% off). No documented Black Friday-specific figure or all-time low was found. Lowest tracked $83 (plugindeals.net (Gear4Music) 2023-12-25).

Toontrack Superior Drummer 3.notes: Toontrack. Not confirmed as sold on Plugin Boutique. Regular $399, standard sale $299 (25% off) — a forum user calls this one of the best prices ever seen since SD3 rarely discounts. A $251.26 price using a stacked BestService coupon code appears in a single forum post but is treated as an unconfirmed one-off, not a tracked all-time low.

GetGood Drums Modern & Massive 2.notes: GetGood Drums. Not confirmed sold on Plugin Boutique (direct-from-GGD only in available data). Regular price $219; no dated sale, Black Friday percentage, or all-time-low figures were found despite GGD being known generally to run seasonal sales.

Antares Auto-Tune Pro.notes: Antares. Auto-Tune Pro 11 lists at $450-$500 depending on source; Spring 2026 flash sale cut it to $250 (50% off). Plugin Boutique is a confirmed Antares reseller, though the $150/72%-off low documented Nov 25, 2025 was for the separate, cheaper 'Auto-Tune 2026' tier, not Pro.

Celemony Melodyne 5 Studio.notes: Celemony. Not sold on Plugin Boutique (only upgrades/updates appear at third-party shops). $699 web-shop price is a permanent 17% markdown off the $849 MSRP, not a limited sale. Deep discounts (e.g. 80% off) apply only to version-upgrade paths, not new full licenses.

iZotope Nectar 4.notes: iZotope. Sold on Plugin Boutique. Prices shown are for the Standard tier ($199 reg., $149.25 current promo); the Advanced tier is $299 regular. The $129 all-time low (57% off, Aug 17, 2025, plugindeals.net) is documented specifically for the Advanced tier at Plugin Boutique, not Standard.

Waves Tune Real-Time.notes: Waves. Not confirmed as sold on Plugin Boutique (no PB listing found in research). Effectively in a near-permanent sale at $49.99 (75% off $199 MSRP); related Waves Tune LT drops to $34.99 (65% off $99).

Baby Audio Spaced Out.notes: Baby Audio. Substituted for the non-existent 'Baby Audio Parametric'. Regular price $99 one-time. A follow-up query to confirm Plugin Boutique listing and sale history failed (Perplexity API quota error), so PB status and sale pricing are unconfirmed — treat this entry as provisional until re-researched.

FabFilter Pro-DS.notes: FabFilter de-esser. Discounts ~25% once/year at Black Friday only, matching FabFilter's site-wide pattern (never runs percentage sales otherwise).

FabFilter Pro-MB.notes: FabFilter multiband compressor. ~25% off Black Friday only; full price rest of year.

FabFilter Pro-G.notes: FabFilter gate/expander. ~25% off Black Friday only; full price rest of year.

FabFilter Saturn 2.notes: FabFilter multiband saturation/distortion. ~25% off Black Friday only.

FabFilter Volcano 3.notes: FabFilter filter plugin. ~25% off Black Friday only.

FabFilter Timeless 3.notes: FabFilter tape-style delay. ~25% off Black Friday only.

FabFilter Twin 3.notes: FabFilter subtractive/wavetable synth. ~25% off Black Friday only.

u-he Zebra 3.notes: u-he's newest flagship modular synth (successor to Zebra2/ZebraHZ). Sold direct from u-he; occasional 20-30% off during u-he's infrequent sales (BF/anniversary).

u-he Zebra Legacy.notes: Zebra 2 + extras, u-he's older workhorse synth. Sold direct; included in u-he's infrequent global sales at ~20-30% off.

u-he ACE.notes: u-he semi-modular synth (Any Cable Everywhere). Sold direct; ~20-30% off during u-he's infrequent sales.

u-he Presswerk.notes: u-he compressor. Sold primarily direct; ~20-30% off during u-he's infrequent Black Friday/holiday sales.

u-he Colour Copy.notes: u-he bucket-brigade-style delay. Sold direct; ~20-30% off during u-he's infrequent sales.

Native Instruments FM8.notes: 6-operator FM synth. NI repriced legacy synths to flat $99. Documented flash sale to $10 (synthanatomy.com, Aug 2023) - likely a one-off, treat as unconfirmed floor; typical NI Summer/Black Friday sale ~50% off ($49-29).

Native Instruments Reaktor 6.notes: Modular synth platform, full (non-Player) license. NI repriced to $99; 50% off common in NI Summer Sale/Black Friday.

Native Instruments Battery 4.notes: Drum sampler/synth flagship. Included in Komplete; ~50% off in NI's Summer Sale and Black Friday (2-3x/year).

Native Instruments Guitar Rig 7 Pro.notes: Guitar amp/FX suite. Documented 50% off sale to $94.50 (Sept 2025, rekkerd.org/NI promo) - recurs in NI's regular seasonal sales.

Native Instruments Replika XT.notes: NI delay effect, part of the $49 FX tier. ~50% off in NI Summer Sale/Black Friday.

Native Instruments Raum.notes: NI reverb effect, part of the $49 FX tier. ~50% off in NI Summer Sale/Black Friday.

Native Instruments Supercharger GT.notes: NI compressor effect, part of the $49 FX tier. ~50% off in NI Summer Sale/Black Friday.

Native Instruments Action Strings.notes: NI-published Kontakt cinematic string ostinato library. ~50% off in NI's big instrument sales (Summer of Sound/Black Friday).

Native Instruments Discovery Series West.notes: NI-published world instrument Kontakt library. Consistently ~50% off in NI's major instrument sales.

Native Instruments Strummed Acoustic 2.notes: NI-published pattern-based acoustic guitar Kontakt library. ~50% off in NI's major instrument sales.

Arturia Analog Lab.notes: Unified preset player for all Arturia synths/keyboards. Arturia runs 30-50% off promos (Spring/Summer/Black Friday); comparable Arturia titles record lows of 40-60% off.

Arturia Mini V.notes: Minimoog emulation, one of the most popular V Collection instruments. 30-50% off in Arturia's frequent seasonal sales.

Arturia Jup-8 V.notes: Roland Jupiter-8 emulation. 30-50% off in Arturia's frequent seasonal sales.

Arturia CS-80 V.notes: Yamaha CS-80 emulation. 30-50% off in Arturia's frequent seasonal sales.

Arturia Prophet V.notes: Sequential Prophet-5 emulation. 30-50% off in Arturia's frequent seasonal sales.

Arturia Piano V.notes: Arturia's flagship modeled acoustic piano. 30-50% off in Arturia's frequent seasonal sales.

Arturia Augmented STRINGS.notes: Hybrid synthesized/sampled string instrument from Arturia's Augmented series. 30-50% off in Arturia's frequent seasonal sales.

iZotope VocalSynth 2.notes: Vocal harmonizer/vocoder. iZotope's Black Friday 'Creative Effects' promo repeatedly prices it at $29 (~85% off) - a recurring, documented sale point.

iZotope Trash 2.notes: Multiband distortion/mangling. iZotope's Black Friday 'Creative Effects' promo prices it at $29 alongside VocalSynth 2.

iZotope Iris 2.notes: Sample-based spectral synth, now legacy/bundle-status product. Reportedly discounted to $9.99-29 in past creative-bundle campaigns (dates unconfirmed - treat as unconfirmed floor).

iZotope Insight 2.notes: Loudness/metering/surround monitoring suite. Less aggressively discounted than creative tools; typically ~50% off in major sales.

iZotope Tonal Balance Control 2.notes: Spectral reference/mix-balance tool, often included free with other iZotope purchases. Follows iZotope's typical 70%+ off Black Friday pattern when sold standalone.

Waves H-Delay.notes: Hybrid delay. Waves' near-permanent discounting means it's rarely full price; commonly $14.99-29.99 in flash sales.

Waves H-Reverb.notes: Hybrid reverb. Frequently $19.99-29.99 in Waves' constant flash-sale cycle.

Waves Renaissance Reverb.notes: Classic algorithmic reverb (R-Verb). Regularly seen at $19.99 or lower in Waves' 'any plugin' sales.

Waves L1 Ultramaximizer.notes: Classic brickwall limiter. Commonly $19.99-29.99 in Waves flash sales; deeper 'Mega Sale' promos can reach ~$14.99.

Waves Vocal Rider.notes: Automatic vocal level rider. Frequently $19.99-29.99 in Waves sales, occasionally $14.99.

Waves API 2500.notes: API-modeled stereo bus compressor. Commonly $24.99-39.99 in Waves' frequent promotions.

Waves PuigTec EQP-1A.notes: Pultec-style passive EQ modeled by Jack Joseph Puig. Regularly $19.99-29.99 in Waves 'any plugin' events.

Waves Abbey Road Reverb Plates.notes: Abbey Road studio plate reverb emulation. Commonly $24.99-39.99 in Waves sales.

Waves Renaissance Vox.notes: Vocal compressor/leveler (R-Vox). One of the most frequently deep-discounted Waves plugins, often under $19.99.

Waves Kramer Master Tape.notes: Eddie Kramer-designed tape machine emulation. Commonly $19.99-24.99 in Waves' frequent promotions.

Soundtoys Decapitator.notes: Flagship analog-modeled saturation. Drops to ~$69-79 (~65% off) in Soundtoys' Summer/Black Friday sales. Lowest tracked $40 (plugindeals.net (Thomann) 2024-11-27).

Soundtoys EchoBoy.notes: Flagship multi-mode analog delay emulation. Same ~$69-79 sale pattern as Decapitator.

Soundtoys Little AlterBoy.notes: Pitch/formant vocal shifter, often an entry-level Soundtoys purchase. Drops to ~$34-49 in major sales.

Soundtoys Devil-Loc Deluxe.notes: Aggressive analog-style compressor. Drops to ~$24-39 (~60% off) in Soundtoys sales.

Soundtoys FilterFreak.notes: Dual analog-modeled filter effect. Drops to ~$49-59 (~65-75% off) in Soundtoys sales.

Soundtoys Crystallizer.notes: Pitch-shifting reverse-delay/texture effect, part of the flagship $199 tier. Same sale pattern as Decapitator/EchoBoy.

Soundtoys PanMan.notes: Rhythmic auto-pan effect. Same $99-tier sale pattern (~50-65% off) as other mid-tier Soundtoys plugins.

Soundtoys Tremolator.notes: Tremolo/rhythmic volume effect. Same $99-tier sale pattern as other mid-tier Soundtoys plugins.

Soundtoys MicroShift.notes: Detune/chorus-style pitch-shifting stereo widener. Same $99-tier sale pattern as other mid-tier Soundtoys plugins.

Softube Summit Audio TLA-100A.notes: Summit Audio tube compressor emulation. Softube runs seasonal sales (Summer, Black Friday, 'Releases Rewind') up to 70-75% off.

Softube Tube-Tech CL 1B.notes: Premium Tube-Tech compressor emulation, one of Softube's priciest single plugins. Up to 75% off in Softube's major sales. Lowest tracked $56.5 (plugindeals.net (Plugin Boutique) 2024-11-28).

Softube Trident A-Range.notes: Trident console channel EQ/compressor emulation. Up to 70-75% off in Softube's seasonal sales.

Softube Model 72.notes: Moog-style filter/synth voice. Included in Softube's seasonal sales at ~50-70% off.

Softube Drawmer S73.notes: Drawmer channel strip emulation. Up to 70-75% off in Softube's seasonal sales.

Softube Weiss DS1-MK3.notes: Weiss mastering compressor emulation, premium tier alongside Tube-Tech. Up to 75% off in Softube's major sales.

Plugin Alliance bx_console SSL 4000E.notes: Brainworx SSL 4000E console channel strip emulation. Regularly included in PA's famous recurring 'Any Plugin $29.99' promo, which functions as the de facto floor price.

Plugin Alliance bx_console Neve 88RS.notes: Brainworx Neve 88RS console channel strip emulation. Included in PA's recurring 'Any Plugin $29.99' promo.

Plugin Alliance Maag EQ4.notes: Maag Audio EQ4 'Air Band' EQ emulation. Included in PA's recurring 'Any Plugin $29.99' promo.

Plugin Alliance SPL Vitalizer.notes: SPL psychoacoustic enhancer/exciter. Included in PA's recurring 'Any Plugin $29.99' promo.

Plugin Alliance Lindell 80 Series.notes: Lindell Audio console-style channel strip emulation. Included in PA's recurring 'Any Plugin $29.99' promo.

Plugin Alliance Shadow Hills Mastering C.notes: Shadow Hills mastering compressor emulation. Included in PA's recurring 'Any Plugin $29.99' promo.

Plugin Alliance Elysia niveau filter.notes: Elysia niveau filter EQ emulation. Included in PA's recurring 'Any Plugin $29.99' promo.

UAD LA-2A Collection.notes: Teletronix LA-2A compressor collection, native/Spark compatible. UA's storewide 'up to 80% off' events cut it to ~$49-59.

UAD Neve 1073.notes: Neve 1073 preamp/EQ channel strip emulation. UA storewide sales bring flagship strips to ~$79-99.

UAD Pultec Passive EQ Collection.notes: Pultec EQP-1A/MEQ-5 passive EQ collection. Drops to ~$39-49 in UA's 'up to 80% off' storewide events.

UAD Studer A800.notes: Studer A800 multitrack tape machine emulation. Documented reseller listing $199 -> $39 (~80% off) during a UA-aligned sale (exact date unconfirmed).

UAD Oxide Tape Recorder.notes: Simplified tape saturation/coloration plugin, often bundled in UAD Essentials Edition. ~$29-49 in UA's big sales.

UAD API Vision Channel Strip.notes: API console-style channel strip (preamp/EQ/dynamics). ~$79-99 in UA's storewide sales.

Spitfire Symphony Orchestra.notes: Spitfire's core full-orchestra library. Frequently 30-50% off in Spring/Summer/Black Friday sales; forum reports of ~half-price runs in 2025-2026.

Spitfire Albion ONE.notes: Spitfire's flagship hybrid orchestral toolkit. Commonly 30-40% off in major sales; 50% off has occurred in catalogue-wide promos.

Spitfire Albion Colossus.notes: Large-scale Albion series orchestral library. Reddit-reported sale ~$225 (unconfirmed exact date/source credibility) - noted here as unconfirmed, not used as all_time_low.

Spitfire Studio Orchestra.notes: Spitfire's Studio Strings/Brass/Woodwinds family, intimate-scale recordings. 30-50% off in Spitfire's catalogue-wide sales.

Spitfire Chamber Strings.notes: Spitfire's specialist chamber string ensemble library. 30-40% off (occasionally 50%) in Spitfire's big sales.

Spitfire Eric Whitacre Choir.notes: Flagship Spitfire choir library (also available via Splice Rent-to-Own). 30-40% off in Spitfire's major sales.

Spitfire Cinematic Soft Piano.notes: Spitfire Originals-series budget piano library. Standard Originals price pattern: $29 regular, ~$24 on frequent mild sales, occasionally ~$20 in bigger promos (Black Friday).

Output Substance.notes: Output's Kontakt-based bass sound-design engine. 30-50% off in Black Friday/Output seasonal sales; deeper in multi-instrument bundles. Lowest tracked $69 (plugindeals.net (Plugin Boutique) 2023-11-27).

Output Analog Strings.notes: Hybrid orchestral/modern strings engine. 30-40% off on Black Friday and Output seasonal sales.

Output Analog Brass and Winds.notes: Hybrid brass/woodwinds engine, often paired with Analog Strings in bundles. 30-40% off on Black Friday.

Output Signal.notes: Pulse/rhythmic sample engine, one of Output's earliest hits. 40-50% off common on Black Friday.

Output EXHALE.notes: Modern vocal engine (Kontakt). 30-40% off on Output's major sales.

Output Movement.notes: Modulation/motion effects rack. Follows Output's Black Friday 30-40% off pattern.

Output Thermal.notes: Distortion/saturation effects rack. Follows Output's Black Friday 30-40% off pattern.

Baby Audio Super VHS.notes: Lo-fi/retro multi-effect. No permanent PB discount observed at list; Baby Audio's frequent flash/BF sales bring it to ~$29-39.

Baby Audio Comeback Kid.notes: Delay plugin. Documented Black Friday 2025 sale price $29 (~58% off) via a BF sale roundup video.

Baby Audio Parallel Aggressor.notes: Parallel compression/multiband dynamics tool. Same $29-39 flash-sale tier as Super VHS/Comeback Kid.

Baby Audio I Heart NY.notes: Original parallel compressor, Baby Audio's lower-cost tier. ~$19-29 in larger promotions.

Baby Audio IHNY-2.notes: Flagship successor to I Heart NY. Standard 30-40% off outside marquee sale events; $25 upgrade path from IHNY-1.

Baby Audio Transit 2.notes: Macro-controlled multi-effect engine. PB lists a routine $129->$79 sale (~38% off); documented Black Friday 2025 floor of $69 (~47% off) direct from Baby Audio.

Cherry Audio DCO-106.notes: Roland Juno-106-style polyphonic synth. Included in Cherry Audio's Synth Stack bundle sales at 40-60% off.

Cherry Audio Mercury-4.notes: Mid-tier Cherry Audio synth. Participates in Synth Stack/Blockbuster sales (Cherry Audio has cut comparable synths ~44% off, e.g. $69->$39).

Cherry Audio Voltage Modular Core + Elec.notes: Modular synth environment bundled with Electro Drums expander. Observed at ~50% off in deal trackers/Synth Stack sales.

Cherry Audio PS-20.notes: Korg PS-3300-style polyphonic synth. Effective discount mainly via Synth Stack bundle inclusion (30-50% off bundle-wide).

Kilohearts Carve EQ.notes: Linear-phase graphic EQ snap-in. Most classic snap-ins became free in Kilohearts Essentials (2022+); Carve EQ remains a premium snap-in discounted 30-50% in site-wide sales.

Kilohearts Slice EQ.notes: Surgical parametric EQ snap-in, same premium tier as Carve EQ. 30-50% off in Kilohearts/Plugin Boutique sale events.

Kilohearts Multipass.notes: Multiband splitter/effects host snap-in. Follows Kilohearts' 2-4x/year sale cadence at 30-50% off.

Xfer Nerve.notes: Drum machine/step sequencer. Discounted less aggressively than Serum; ~10-30% off in major multi-brand sales (OTT is a separate free Xfer plugin, not paid).

Xfer Cthulhu.notes: MIDI chord generator/arpeggiator. Modest ~20-30% discounts on Plugin Boutique promos given its already-low price.

Xfer LFO Tool.notes: LFO-based sidechain/modulation utility. ~20-30% off during site-wide promos.

Spectrasonics Trilian.notes: Bass instrument (companion to Omnisphere/Keyscape). Spectrasonics' own store almost never discounts ($299 fixed); authorized dealers (PluginFox, AudioDeluxe, Sweetwater) consistently list ~$279 (~7% off), which is the documented floor.

UVI World Suite.notes: Large world/ethnic instrument collection. 30-40% off in UVI's Black Friday/Summer/Anniversary sales; deeper cuts (~50%) in limited promos.

UVI Model D.notes: Character piano sampled from a Steinway Model D. 30-50% off in UVI's frequent category sales.

UVI Digital Synsations.notes: Collection of classic late-80s/early-90s digital synths. Regularly discounted in UVI's seasonal sales, similar ~40% pattern.

Toontrack EZkeys 2.notes: Piano/songwriting instrument with MIDI performance engine. Toontrack list pages commonly show ~25% off; deeper ~50% off promos occur seasonally (price tier estimated from Toontrack's EZ-series pattern).

Toontrack EZbass.notes: Bass instrument/performance engine, EZ-series sibling to EZkeys/EZdrummer. Same ~25-50% off Toontrack sale pattern (price tier estimated).

Toontrack EZmix 3.notes: Preset-based mixing plugin. Same ~25-50% off Toontrack sale pattern (price tier estimated).

Toontrack Metal! EZX.notes: Popular EZdrummer/Superior Drummer metal drum expansion pack. EZX packs are frequently ~50% off in Toontrack sales (price tier estimated).

XLN Audio Addictive Drums 2.notes: Drum instrument core/collections (e.g. Metal Collection $159 reg). Documented lowest tracked price ~$98 (~38% off, plugindeals.net) during XLN's frequent seasonal sales.

XLN Audio XO.notes: Sample/beat-finding and organization tool. Documented lowest tracked price ~$61 (~59% off, plugindeals.net) in XLN's Black Friday/autumn sales.

XLN Audio Life.notes: Field-recording-to-beat creation system (companion mobile app is free). Participates in XLN's up-to-40% off seasonal promos.

Slate Digital VMR.notes: Virtual Mix Rack channel-strip host (full 3.0 version; a cut-down 'VMR Essentials' exists at $49 perpetual). Slate's perpetual catalog is rarely discounted deeply, unlike Waves/Plugin Alliance.

Slate Digital VTM.notes: Virtual Tape Machine saturation emulation, now mostly bundled into Complete Access. Perpetual license rarely discounted (per Slate's general no-deep-discount reputation).

Slate Digital FG-X.notes: Mastering processor/loudness maximizer. Same rarely-discounted perpetual pricing pattern as other Slate legacy plugins.

Valhalla Plate.notes: Plate reverb. Valhalla's stated policy (company blog, 'Every Day Is Black Friday Here In Valhalla') is a fixed $50 price with NO sales, ever - $50 is both regular and all-time price.

Valhalla Delay.notes: Delay plugin. Same Valhalla no-discount policy: fixed $50 year-round, confirmed via company statement.

Valhalla Ubermod.notes: Modulation effects (chorus/flange/etc). Same Valhalla no-discount policy: fixed $50 year-round.

Valhalla Shimmer.notes: Shimmer/pitch-shifted reverb. Same Valhalla no-discount policy: fixed $50 year-round.

Eventide H3000 Factory.notes: Legendary H3000 harmonizer/multi-effects emulation. Documented 'Pluginpalooza 2026' seasonal sale price $75 (50% off, production-expert.com); recurs yearly.

Eventide Physion.notes: Transient/tonal splitting processor (Physion Mk II). Documented Pluginpalooza 2026 sale price $75 (50% off).

Eventide SP2016 Reverb.notes: Classic SP2016 hardware reverb emulation. Documented Pluginpalooza 2026 sale price $49 (50% off).

Eventide UltraChannel.notes: Channel strip combining EQ/dynamics/harmonizer modules. Same 40-50% off pattern as Eventide's other classics in Pluginpalooza/Black Friday sales.

Eventide Tverb.notes: Creative reverb (upper tier alongside Blackhole/SP2016). 40-50% off in Eventide's recurring seasonal sales.

Sonnox Oxford Dynamics.notes: Flagship compressor/gate/expander. Sonnox's rare-but-deep Summer Sale cuts it 75% off (~GBP59.99/~$77); community notes it's 'normally never in any significant sale'.

Sonnox Oxford Inflator.notes: Loudness/harmonic enhancer. Documented 2025 deal-roundup sale price of $16 (>90% off) during a 'every Sonnox plugin on sale' promo through July 31 2025; Summer Sale otherwise runs ~75% off.

Sonnox Oxford SuprEsser.notes: Dynamic EQ/de-esser. Participates in Sonnox's 75%+ off Summer Sale/catalogue-wide promos same as other Oxford processors (price tier estimated).

Cableguys Kickstart 2.notes: Sidechain-style volume pumping effect. Cableguys runs frequent discounts/upgrade pricing; ~50% off in seasonal promos (price tier estimated).

Cableguys Curve.notes: Drawable-curve modulation effect. Same frequent-discount pattern as other Cableguys tools (price tier estimated).

Newfangled Audio EQuivocate.notes: Human-ear-modeled graphic EQ, also sold as part of the Elevate Mastering Bundle. Historical bundle promo pricing implies ~40-60% off in Eventide/Newfangled sales.

Newfangled Audio Saturate.notes: Spectral clipper/saturator for mastering. Same ~40-60% off pattern as EQuivocate, part of the Elevate Mastering Bundle family.

Newfangled Audio Punctuate.notes: Transient shaper using transient-emphasis technology. Same ~40-60% off pattern, part of the Elevate Mastering Bundle family.

Newfangled Audio Generate.notes: Chaotic polysynth (Newfangled's synth product, distinct from the mastering-tool family). ~30-50% off in Eventide/Newfangled's major sales.

GForce impOSCar 2.notes: Emulation of the OSCar synthesizer. GForce runs periodic sales similar to their OB-E pattern (price tier estimated from GForce's typical range).

GForce M-Tron Pro.notes: Mellotron emulation with expanded tape library. Periodic GForce sales, similar discount pattern to OB-E (price tier estimated).

GForce Oddity 2.notes: ARP Odyssey emulation. Periodic GForce sales, similar discount pattern to OB-E (price tier estimated).

Sonible smart:comp 3.notes: AI-assisted compressor. List $129, reseller sale seen at $59 (~55% off, jrrshop.com); Sonible runs several sales/year.

Sonible smart:limit.notes: AI-assisted loudness limiter, part of the smart:essentials trio ($249 bundle = ~30% off vs buying individually). Same 30-50% off seasonal pattern.

Sonible smart:reverb 2.notes: AI-guided reverb. List $129, reseller sale seen at $59 (~55% off, jrrshop.com).

Sonible proximity:EQ.notes: EQ with proximity/de-reverberation focus, part of Sonible's older EQ line. Reseller sale seen at $29 (~70% off).

Sonible entropy:EQ.notes: Transient/tonal separation EQ. Reseller sale seen at $29 (~70% off), same as proximity:EQ.

oeksound Spiff.notes: Adaptive transient/resonance processor. Sonible-style seasonal sales (Spring/Summer/BF/Dec) commonly bring it to $99 (~38% off), per forum-reported sale pricing.

Wavesfactory Spectre.notes: Creative EQ/saturation tool. 30-50% off in Wavesfactory's major promos (price tier estimated).

Wavesfactory Bass Rider.notes: Bass-level automation/riding utility. 35-50% off typical in sales (price tier estimated).

Klanghelm SDRR.notes: Saturation/character processor. Klanghelm rarely runs deep discounts (already budget-priced); modest ~20% off when promoted.

Klanghelm VUMT Deluxe.notes: Expanded metering/utility suite. Same modest, infrequent Klanghelm discount pattern (~25% off).

AudioThing Outer Space 2.notes: Tape/space-echo delay emulation. Confirmed direct-site sale $69 -> $39 (~43% off); AudioThing runs Summer/Black Friday sales at 35-45% off.

AudioThing Type A.notes: Tape-style noise-reduction/exciter emulation. Confirmed direct-site sale $59 -> $33 (~44% off).

AudioThing Springs.notes: Spring reverb collection (multiple tanks/amps). Same ~35-45% off pattern as AudioThing's other FX (price tier estimated from comparable titles).

Denise Audio Bloom.notes: Creative multi-FX/sound-design tool (distortion/filters/modulation). 30-50% off in store-wide sales, occasionally 65-70% via PB exclusives (price tier estimated).

Denise Audio Warm.notes: Saturation/analog-warmth processor. 30-50% off typical, can drop below $25 in aggressive third-party sales (price tier estimated).

Denise Audio Punch.notes: Transient shaper/punch enhancer. Same 30-50% off pattern as other Denise Audio tools (price tier estimated).

Minimal Audio Current 2.notes: Flagship wavetable/sample-based synth. Confirmed $199 list (jrrshop.com); Minimal Audio runs frequent 40-50% off sales.

Minimal Audio Rift 2.0.notes: Multi-effect distortion/modulation plugin. A specific $64.50 sale price was reported in community deal threads (unconfirmed as absolute lowest); Minimal Audio runs frequent 40-50% off sales.

Excite Audio Bloom Drum Machine.notes: Drum machine instrument (Excite Audio, formerly under W.A. Production). Documented lowest recorded price $29 (~25% off, plugindeals.net).

Heavyocity Gravity.notes: Cinematic sound-design toolkit (Kontakt). Confirmed $179 direct from heavyocity.com; NI/Heavyocity partner sales regularly hit 50% off, 2-3x/year.

Heavyocity Gravity 2.notes: Next-gen cinematic toolkit (Kontakt). Confirmed $249 direct from heavyocity.com; newer flagship so discounts start ~30% before converging to 40-50% in later sales.

Heavyocity Novo.notes: Orchestral strings + modern motion engine. 40-50% off in NI partner sales and Heavyocity's own events (price tier estimated; a cut-down 'Novo Essentials' sells for $99, sale $49.50 confirmed direct).

Heavyocity Ascend.notes: Cinematic prepared/ambient grand piano library (Kontakt/NKS). 30-50% off in Heavyocity's site-wide sales (price tier estimated).

Heavyocity Damage 2.notes: Flagship hybrid/epic percussion instrument (Kontakt/NKS). 30-50% off in Heavyocity's site-wide and NI partner sales (price tier estimated).

ProjectSAM Symphobia 2.notes: Flagship orchestral texture library. Documented all-time low $179 (~45% off, recorded 11/04/2022 via a Native Instruments partner sale, musicsoftwaredeals.com). ProjectSAM's standard Black Friday discount is 30% off storewide.

ProjectSAM True Strike 2.notes: Orchestral percussion library. ProjectSAM's Black Friday sale is a consistent '30% off all individual libraries' (price tier estimated from comparable ProjectSAM titles).

ProjectSAM Orchestral Essentials 2.notes: More affordable full-orchestra 'essentials' library vs. Symphobia. Same 30% off storewide Black Friday pattern (price tier estimated).

EastWest Hollywood Orchestra Opus Editio.notes: EastWest's flagship full-orchestra perpetual library. Documented permanent price drop from $995 to $399 (vi-control.net forum thread on EastWest's permanent price drops); further seasonal sales may apply on top.

EastWest Fab Four.notes: Beatles-style guitars/bass/drums/keys instrument collection. Documented permanent price drop from $299 to $149 (vi-control.net).

EastWest Ghostwriter.notes: Composing/songwriting-focused instrument collection. Documented permanent price drop from $299 to $149 (vi-control.net).
